title: Providing Aluminium partition wall to back verandah of staff quarters & Inspection Quarters at Mount Dilli Lighthouse
summary: Sealed quotation for providing a powder-coated aluminium partition wall to the back verandah of the staff quarters and inspection quarters, plus aluminium angle fixing to shutters, at Mount Dilli Lighthouse (Ezhimala, Payyannoor).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Mount Dilli Lighthouse
sites.work: Aluminium partition wall to back verandah of staff quarters and inspection quarters; aluminium angles on shutters

scope.item: Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/by mechanical means incl. stacking of steel bars and disposal within 50 m lead (rate Rs 4,115.19; amount Rs 2,057.59)
12 mm cement plaster 1:3 finished with floating coat of neat cement (rate Rs 509.00; amount Rs 2,036.01)

Providing and fixing powder coated heavy gauge aluminium partition wall partially panelled with 4 mm ACP sheet, sliding glazed window, mosquito net window, aluminium door with frame, shutter, handle, lock, 4 mm float glass (rate Rs 5,808.00; amount Rs 1,91,664.00)

Providing and fixing aluminium angle 30x30x2 mm (0.313 kg/m) to bottom of wooden window/door/cupboard shutters of staff quarters/IQ/office to prevent entry of snakes/rats, incl. planing (rate Rs 645.00; amount Rs 30,960.00)

money.performance_security: 5% of quoted amount by DD/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam
money.notes: Schedule total Rs 2,26,717.61; bidders quote percentage below/above, inclusive of all materials, labour, transport, scaffolding and GST. No EMD mentioned. No escalation.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order

eligibility: Submit copy of PAN card, GST registration and bank account details
Lowest quoted amount decides successful contractor; company bidders need authorisation letter
specs: Powder coated heavy gauge aluminium partition with 4 mm ACP panels and 4 mm float glass
notes: NIQ dated 24.02.2026.
